variants.name: A · 钩索破空
variants.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: finished game cover thumbnail for the mature atmospheric 2D vertical action adventure 裂隙. Landscape 4:3 composition, ideally 1536x1152.
Input images: image 1 is the existing game's protagonist and must preserve character identity; image 2 is the existing game's actual gothic inverted-city environment and supplies architectural/material style. Transform and recompose these supplied game assets into ONE polished standalone cover illustration. Do not show a reference sheet or collage.
Character invariants: slender adult proportions, pointed charcoal hood, weathered ivory beaked half-mask with face concealed, layered charcoal split long coat, worn brass mechanical right forearm/gauntlet, short burnt-orange scarf, slim dark boots. No exposed human face, no new protagonist design.
Visual world: ruined vertical gothic city, ornate aged brass and pale carved stone, vast hanging towers and suspended architectural fragments, storm blue atmospheric depth. Use bells only as occasional architectural details, never as the central subject.
Text verbatim: "裂隙". Exactly these two Chinese characters, correctly formed, beautifully typeset and readable at thumbnail size. No English text, subtitle, slogan, label, badge, border, UI, health bar, skill icon or watermark.
Thumbnail constraint: clear big light/dark masses and a readable character silhouette at 232x172px. Keep all important character and title inside central 82% width and 74% height so 16:9 and 4:3 display crops both work. Full bleed artwork, no mockup frame. Refined, adult, tactile, hand-crafted high quality game key art; never cartoon/chibi or glossy mobile-game neon.
Art direction A: kinetic cinematic adventure. The protagonist is caught at the apex of a grappling swing across a deep chasm; right brass gauntlet holds one taut thin grappling cable that sweeps diagonally up toward a real anchor on broken stone architecture. A powerful S-curve of long coat and rusty orange scarf expresses momentum. Hero fills about 44% of image height, positioned in right-central frame, whole body and mask clearly legible. Behind the hero, cool slate-blue mist separates ruined hanging arches in three depth planes. One bright warm shaft of light edges the hood and gauntlet; only a few sparks/stone fragments, restrained particles. Strong asymmetric diagonal composition and rich painterly surfaces. Place the title 裂隙 large in pale warm ivory in a quiet darker area at left-center; roughly 25% image width. This must instantly communicate grappling traversal and danger, not a static standing portrait. Do not add enemies or extra characters.
